bead.title: routing P1: shared failure-classification table + classifier
bead.description: Single shared classifier mapping each attempt outcome to the action in the FEAT-004 addendum table (genuine-failure=escalate; no_changes/dirty/transport/quota/auth do NOT escalate). See docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-004-model-routing.md 'Addendum: tiered, quota-aware routing' for the normative model + failure-classification table.
bead.acceptance: 1. classifier maps every table row to an action enum. 2. table-driven test covers every row. 3. genuine-failure vs no_changes distinction tested. 4. go test green. 5. lefthook passes.
